## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.19 — Restricted profiles, sticky heading, recording tail

> **Alpha.** Four fixes from testing alpha.18.

### You could not get out of Settings

Under a lights-only or sync-only profile the bottom bar showed **only**
Settings, so opening it left nothing that could go back — and since the profile
setting lives on that page, the only escape was to change the profile you had
gone there to change.

The nav hid the single feature tab on the grounds that a permanently-active
link is noise. It is worse than noise. Every tab that exists now gets a link.

### The sticky room heading leaked

Its background was exactly as wide as the cards, so a card scrolling underneath
showed in the gap beside it. It now reaches the screen edges while its text
stays lined up with the cards.

### A recording lost its last frame

Your log showed `in=2122 out=2121` — one frame handed to the encoder and never
written. On stopping, the code gave up as soon as the encoder said "nothing
ready yet", which is right while recording and wrong at the end, where the
encoder simply has not finished. One frame is trivial, but the same step
decides whether the file's end marker is written, and a slower encoder would
lose more.

### Diagnostics can now show the downscale

The colour-pipeline size printed only from a running capture, so a report taken
after stopping — which is when anyone takes one — left it out entirely. It is
now written to the log when it changes, and the last known value is printed
when capture is not running.

### On the 1.6 inbound fps

Not a fault, and not battery throttling. That reading was taken ten seconds
after capture stopped, so it is an average decaying to zero. Separately, the
screen mirror only produces a frame when something on screen changes — a still
screen legitimately produces almost none, and the lights have nothing to react
to anyway.
